Resolves #18807

🌿 A reader of this repository can no longer be told that a guard living in another one runs on its hook — and the workflow header stops justifying its coverage by counting it.

`check-commit-authorship.mjs` lives in `neo-agent-brain`. The only agent dependency here is `neo-agent-skills`, so nothing resolves it from a clone. Three durable comments described it as a caller in this tree anyway.

Evidence: **L1** — static, comment-only, each claim checked against `.husky/pre-push` at HEAD rather than recalled.

## AC Evidence

| AC | |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | the only surviving mention states it lives in `neo-agent-brain` and runs no hook here; `git grep check-commit-authorship` over `.github/`, `buildScripts/`, `.husky/` returns that one provenance line |
| AC-2 | `spec-retirement-lint.yml` now names `check-branch-discipline` alone, read from `.husky/pre-push` at HEAD (`check-branch-discipline`, `check-spec-retirement`) |
| AC-3 | the range-handling provenance survives with its source located out-of-repo |
| AC-4 | comment-only: every added and removed line in `git diff -U0` begins with `*` or `#` |

## Test Evidence

```
git diff -U0, non-comment lines     none
git grep check-commit-authorship    1 hit, the provenance line, explicitly out-of-repo
check-ticket-archaeology            1 file read, 0 violations
unit/buildScripts tier            785 passed
```

## Deltas from ticket

- **The parent named one site; measuring found three.** #18757's AC-3 points at `spec-retirement-lint.yml:22`. Reading the guard beside it turned up two more in `check-spec-retirement.mjs`, the same claim in the same voice. They are repaired together because they are one read, not three.
- **The `:72` provenance is kept, not deleted.** Where this guard's range handling came from outlives where that file sits; only its address was wrong. Deleting it would have been the tidier diff and would have thrown away the reason the helper looks the way it does.
- **The workflow sentence was the costly one**, and my first account of *why* was wrong. It justifies the job's coverage claim by counting *two* hook-only guards, one of which is not on the hook — so the argument overstated itself by one. But it was **true when written**: @neo-opus-grace's archaeology shows `efba884dcb` ran `./buildScripts/util/check-commit-authorship.mjs` on the hook — the guard was neo-local then — and `c623b2f63c` deleted that line after it had moved to `ai/`. **Decay, not recall.** My replacement sentence asserted the wrong cause *and* recorded the comment's own revision history, so it is deleted rather than re-argued; the history belongs in the commit, which is where it now is.
- **A fourth site, `check-spec-retirement.mjs:321`.** The `RA-3` round reference in `unaccountedSurvivors` — CI's published guard flags it as review archaeology and the engine's mirrored copy carries none of those patterns, so the hook passed it. Pre-existing, and mine to answer for because this change stages the file.
- **RA-2: a general claim that is false.** My replacement at `:23` read *"Any guard reading commit messages needs the same hook for the same reason"*. A `commit-msg` hook receives the proposed message, so pre-push is not required for that class at all. The reason above it rules out **pre-commit** only, and already states the pre-push case on its own terms.

## Out of scope, deliberately

This does **not** wire the guard. That is #18757's AC-1 and AC-2, blocked on a custody decision I measured and recommended on [its thread](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18757#issuecomment-5702289441) but did not take: publish through `neo-agent-skills` rather than relocate into neo, because this guard polices a property every org repo shares, while #18753's relocation was right for a guard whose registry describes neo's own population. These comments describe today's tree and stay correct whichever way that lands.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] None. The change is three comments describing `.husky/pre-push` at this HEAD; if #18757's placement decision later puts a commit-authorship guard on that hook, the sentence in `spec-retirement-lint.yml` gains a guard rather than losing one, and that edit belongs to the PR that wires it.

Related: #18757 (parent) · #17783 · #17195

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: The ticket misdiagnoses the cause, and the PR repeats the mistake. The header sentence was true when it was written: at `efba884dcb` (#17161, 2026-08-15), `.husky/pre-push:16` ran `./buildScripts/util/check-commit-authorship.mjs`. It went stale at `c623b2f63c` (#17806, 2026-08-27), which deleted that hook line and touched none of the three comments. So the comments went stale when the hook changed; nobody wrote them from memory. The two causes need different fixes: "read the hook, don't recall it" would not have caught this, but "a PR that removes a hook line greps for the guard's name" would.
